items.title: Can an AI Agent Be Trusted With a Brokerage Account? Rule Compliance of Trading Agents Under Pressure From Their Principal
items.claim: Counterfeit authorization fooled every trading agent tested, proving rule compliance cannot rely on model judgment alone.

items.title: Where Should the LLM Sit? Architectural Defenses Against Document-Borne Prompt Injection in Automated Credit Underwriting
items.claim: Prompt defenses fail to stop instruction attacks on credit underwriting LLMs that make lending decisions.

items.title: Auto-Alpha: A Framework for Autonomous Factor Research
items.claim: Auto-Alpha's 16.81% annualized returns lack controlled evaluation, so component contributions remain unproven.

items.title: Path-Independent Deleveraging Rules
items.claim: Intermediate deleveraging parameters dominate Hyperliquid's observed allocation in both fairness and platform risk.
